notes.title: Version 1.07 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.07 Update 
[list]
[*] Remapped and improved Vive Controllers 
[*] Improved Oculus Touch Controllers 
[*] Added support for multiple different sound types including 5.1 surround Sound, 7.1 Surround and ProLogic
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.06 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] For Keyboard Control - moved the Map Key from “M” to “Q” for easier access. 
[*] Improved messaging for which controller provides the best experience.
[/list]
